captionEn: Stained patio concrete back to clean
captionEs: Concreto manchado del patio de nuevo limpio
notes: Screened lanai/patio. Same speckled concrete texture and gray color on both sides, just dirt and stains lifted. No fresh paint sheen or new color, so this reads as CLEANED concrete, not a painted/coated floor. Verdict: patio/outdoor, not interior-painting.

captionEn: Grimy moldy fridge to spotless shelves
captionEs: Refri sucio y con moho a estantes impecables
notes: Frigidaire interior. Before has food, sticky shelves and black mold along the bottom gasket; after is emptied and gleaming white. One of the strongest transformations. Flagship.

captionEn: Caked spill to bright clean drawers
captionEs: Derrame pegado a cajones limpios y blancos
notes: Pull-out crisper/drawer rack. Before has a dried yellow spill, food crust and gunk; after is pristine white. High-impact closeup. Flagship.

captionEn: Cloudy soap scum to clear glass
captionEs: Vidrio opaco por jabon a vidrio transparente
notes: Framed glass shower door with squeegee in before shot. Before is fogged with hard-water and soap-scum film; after is clear enough to see the tile and door handle through it.

captionEn: Rust-stained tub to bright white bathroom
captionEs: Tina con oxido a bano blanco y reluciente
notes: Tub, tiled wall and toilet. Before is heavy with rust and orange staining, mildew on grout and a filthy toilet rim; after is clean white throughout. Most dramatic single image. Flagship.

content: Shower tile wall with handheld showerheads
captionEn: Dingy grout and tile freshened up
captionEs: Lechada y azulejo opacos quedan frescos
notes: Tiled shower wall with two handheld heads and hoses. Before grout is dingy and a hose is corroded; after tile and grout are noticeably brighter. Real but more modest improvement, so not a flagship.

content: Kitchen counters, sink and tile floor
captionEn: Cluttered grimy kitchen to clean and clear
captionEs: Cocina desordenada y sucia a limpia y despejada
notes: Kitchen with cabinets, double sink, dishwasher and tile floor. Before is cluttered with a grimy floor and an open broken cabinet; after is cleared, wiped down and the floor is clean. Reads as a move-out/turnover clean.

content: Bathroom toilet, tub and tile floor
captionEn: Filthy toilet and floor to fresh bathroom
captionEs: Inodoro y piso sucios a bano fresco
notes: Toilet, tub and tiled floor. Before has heavy staining around the toilet base, a stained bowl and dirty grout; after is clean with a fresh vanity in view. Strong transformation and a close runner-up to flagship status.

content: Kitchen with electric range and tile floor
captionEs: Cocina con cosas regadas queda despejada y limpia
notes: Galley kitchen with white electric range, cabinets and tile floor. Before has counter clutter and grime; after is cleared and wiped. Modest improvement; reads as a move-out/turnover clean.
